title: Maintainerr
name: maintainerr
description: Library tidier for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. You write rules like "nobody's watched it in six months", it gathers what matches into a leaving-soon collection, then has Sonarr and Radarr delete it once the grace period's up. Source: https://github.com/Maintainerr/Maintainerr

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Like Europe/London, for when the rules run

note: Open http://<your-host>:6246 and pick your media server, then add Sonarr, Radarr and Seerr under Services if you use them. There's no login at all, so anyone who can reach it can change your rules and delete your media - keep it on your own network, or behind a proxy that asks for a password. Each rule's collection waits out a grace period (30 days unless you change it) before anything's deleted, so you can check what it caught first. The database and logs live in the /opt/data volume. It sends an anonymous usage report once a week, on until you switch it off under Settings --> About --> Telemetry. Docs: docs.maintainerr.info
